rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for sending or transferring money, especially by bank transfer.

example.english: I need to remit the money to you today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gwo3 sou3 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for everyday forgiveness of a person or a wrong.

example.english: I remit your offense this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 loeng6 nei5 gam1 ci3 ge3 gwo3 co3

rows.note: Use this when formally stating that a duty, payment, or other obligation is waived or cancelled.

example.english: The school formally announced that it would remit tuition fees for this semester.
example.traditional: 校方正式宣布免除今個學期嘅學費。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 zing3 sik1 syun1 bou3 min5 ceoi4 gam1 go3 hok6 kei4 ge3 hok6 fai3
